Identity.title: ESB-A / ESB-B candidate — inbound HL7 integration

required_effects: CANDIDATE ONLY — Read data from a logical external data source (exact query and cardinality require review)
CANDIDATE ONLY — Transmit a message to a logical destination (protocol and response require review)

KnownLimitations: Assumed functional intent equivalence is a precondition and not evidence of equivalence.
Common effect categories are preliminary; identical types do not establish identical semantics.
Operation sequence numbers are presentation indices, NOT verified execution order.
Static XML exports cannot establish delivery, state transitions or end-to-end behavior.
Original business rules, mappings, schemas, destination identity and secrets are not copied into this candidate.
Explicitly missing capability on either side blocks a claim of observed compliance.
Not executable, not complete, not an approved normative JSON schema.
This candidate was extracted from the inbound HL7 interface pair, NOT the previously analyzed scheduled interface.
ESB-B database_write is a classifier-only signal from shared database helper code; its reachability and effect on this interface are NOT established.
ESB-A includes a disabled database destination; inactive components must not be silently treated as required functional effects.
Original exports were replaced with redacted evidence views before public release; their omitted code and payloads prevent functional reconstruction.
